Hi Emily — thanks for sending these over and for the clear timing note. Quick answers / clarifying questions from our side:

- DocuSign is fine; we typically attach SCCs and any jurisdiction-specific addenda (UK IDTA) as annexes to the primary DPA in the same envelope. Is Kirkland comfortable with a single-envelope flow?
- Regarding subprocessors: we'll provide a current export and an update cadence (30-day notice for new subprocessors + public registry). Is that OK from your audit side?
- For the transfer-impact summary: would a 1-page summary plus a short appendix covering likelihood of onward transfers satisfy your compliance reviewers? We plan to note that Redwood uses EU-hosted clusters for EU customers by default, with fallbacks to regional replicas only for customer-requested dedicated capacity.

If the single-envelope approach is acceptable, we'll prepare our counters this week and route to you via DocuSign. Laura — can you aim to have counters back to Marissa by Thursday EOD? Neha — can you prepare the 1-page transfer-impact sheet by Thursday as well?

Regards,

Emily / team — thanks for the redlines. I've completed an internal pass and attached our clean DPA + an annotated response. Summary of material points from Kirkland's redlines:

1) Liability cap and carve-outs — we can accept a limited increase for breach-related direct damages up to 6 months of fees, but cannot accept unlimited liability for indirect customers or unclear multi-party claims.
2) SCCs + UK IDTA — Redwood will attach the EU SCCs (2021) and the UK IDTA addendum as annexes to the DPA. We request a mutual statement that the SCCs/addendum are incorporated and that either party may replace them with successor binding mechanisms when issued by regulators.
3) Subprocessors — attached is Redwood_Subprocessors_202703.xlsx. We will commit to 30 days' notice for new subprocessors; for dedicated/private deployments we can discuss longer notice and on-prem options.
4) Transfer-impact summary — draft included as a one-pager in the attached doc (see Redwood_DPA_Clean_v2.docx appendix). It references data mapping: EEA production regions -> EU-hosted clusters; backups in UK only where requested.

Execution proposal: single DocuSign envelope containing: (a) Executed DPA (clean), (b) EU SCCs (completed and signed by reference), (c) UK IDTA addendum (if Kirkland requires). Please confirm:
- If you accept our counters with the mutual-successor clause, we prepare DocuSign by Friday 2027-03-05 and request signature within 7 calendar days.
- We will deliver subprocessor export as a spreadsheet (attached) and a change-notice process.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Clean_v2.docx (clean + appendix), Redwood_Subprocessors_202703.xlsx, annotated_response_to_kirkland_redlines.pdf
